name: Device Harness Refuses to Be Fooled
note: The harness that drives a real phone is itself a measuring tool, and this gate is the mutation test for it — written after a screen tour reported visiting five screens without leaving the first one.

mutations.name: the harness stops noticing that the screen never changed
mutations.why: Without this check a tap that did nothing looks exactly like a tap that worked. A tour then reports five screens visited while sitting on one, which is what happened.
